newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil shoots higher, spreads firm.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil shoots higher, spreads firm.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures extended earlier gains on Wednesday with November gaining $5.25 a tonne to $213.75 by 1616 GMT.
November's premium over December also widened to $5.75 from $4.25 at the close on Tuesday.

Traders attributed the market's strength to a combination of rising heating oil values in the U.S. and the surprise fall in U.S. distillate stocks as reported by the American Petroleum Institute (API) late on Tuesday.
A squeeze also appeared to be developing in the run-up to the November contract expiry next week, they said.
"There is a bit of a squeeze on the November contract. Open interest is quite big and the contract is expiring soon," said one trader.
Open interest was 26,313 lots on November at Tuesday's close, equivalent to 2.6 million tonnes.
The API reported U.S. distillate stocks fell 429,000 tonnes in the week to November 1. Analysts had expected a rise of around 2.5 million tonnes.
At 1620 GMT Nymex December heating oil futures were 1.53 cents higher at 66.95 cents per gallon.
The strength of gas oil helped lift crude. December Brent was last trading 27 cents higher at $22.46 per barrel.
